material.text: Five clean waves up from Jul 17 to Sep 9 (+71%, wave 1). material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Mar 31 low, the 200-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Jul 29–Sep 11 drop, where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Jul 18, 2022 to Jan 28, 2025 (+115%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−17% to −28%), on lighter volume, with the Sep 12, 2022 high in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−42%); a close over the wave-1 high (+25%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the May high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Uptrend on every average

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +27% in 15 sessions, then drifted for 18 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 15% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.

material.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 36)
material.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 36, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
material.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.
